logp.method_description: The shake-flask method was utilized to measure the log P values of the complexes OH2C–OH8C and AC2C–AC8C. The octanol and PBS used in this experiment were pre-saturated by shaking this biphasic mixture at room temperature overnight. 0.3 mL of PBS solution containing 20 μM complexes of carboplatin, OH2C–OH8C, and AC2C–AC8C were mixed with 0.3 mL of the octanol. The mixtures were kept shaking at 37 °C for 3 h and then separated by centrifugation. After digestion, the platinum content in each phase was determined by ICP-OES. Each sample was tested in triplicate.
